notes.title: REMIX UPDATE AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44750418/db8c6eb3adef6495067ad0cfb6ada468dd32d963.png"]
Check out new music

2 new songs been added to the playlist!



Updated UI

User interface was redisigned to match the vibe. Every screen gets updated.


Game balancing tweaks

Another round of changes to the gameplay and balancing to ensure better expirience.



New achievements

Challenge yourself with 6 new achievements.


Update contains other various fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Patch 2.1
notes.content:
Patch 2.1 is out now

 Fixed size of frostbite effect for giant zombie type
 Fixed probem with low drop rate of permanent bonus card
 Fixed invalid calculation of "no damage" reward
 Difficulty level menu available by default now
 Tweaked difficulty curve
 Decreased number of kill reqauired for the "Endless Horde" achievement (from 100000 to 20000)
 Other minor fixes and improvements

notes.title: Hotfix 2.0.1
notes.content:
Hotfix 2.0.1 is available now!

 New button added for switching between evolution levels

notes.title: EVOLUTION UPDATE AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
EVOLUTION UPDATE AVAILABLE NOW!

Evolve to become stronger!
Reset your level and guns progression to gain new abilities and become even stronger. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44750418/9d47f104ac89e8925683e40892857c49f531d80e.png

Challenge yourself with new difficulty multiplier.
Difficulty multiplier unlocks when you survive 10 or more nights in one game.
With difficulty level multiplies your XP rewards.

Updated shaker!
Now you can hold up to 9 ingredients of the same type in your inventory. Even more, ingredients highlights related cocktail recipies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44750418/4c0f03abf615534612e29c73d0cf18f712e31221.png

Check out your stats.
New statistics menu will provide you with some information and records of your profile.

New achievemnts!
Evolve and fight through hordes with max difficulty multiplier to unlock new achievements.

Update contains other various fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content:
Patch 1.2 is out now

 Other minor fixes and improvements

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.1
notes.content:
Hotfix 1.1.1 is available now!

 Removed unused content
 Changed recipe for "Kill the Reaper" cocktail for a better taste

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Patch 1.1 is out now

 Fixed some problems with localization
 Fireball now becomes hidden while on cooldown
 Selected weapons now auto equip on exiting the upgrade menu
 Fixed problem with "Cokctail Ready" message appearing when no cocktails is actualy ready
 Now you can disable flashing images in setting menu
 Fixed shaker menu not opening while transitioning from day to night
 Other minor fixes and improvements

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hotfix 1.0.1 is out now.

 Fixed achievements not unlocking for killing 500 and 1000 zombies in one game
